def evolved_p97(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i,j] = 1 if (i*i + j*j) <= (N*N // 4) else 0 -- quadratic disk mask
    # Purely position-based (function of row/col indices), no collective needed.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    thresh = (N * N) // 4
    mask = (ii * ii + jj * jj) <= thresh
    return mask.to(x.dtype)
